svg.title: SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard V2.0 implementation timeline
svg.desc: Vertical timeline from June 2026 to 2050 showing publication, effective date, V1 closure, next-cycle target setting, hourly matching step-ups, mandatory ongoing emissions responsibility, and the net-zero deadline.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What was published with CNZS V2.0 on 11 June 2026?')
g.text: Final standard released after two consultations

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What exactly takes effect on 1 February 2027 under CNZS V2.0?')
sendPrompt('What happens to companies still on CNZS Version 1 after 2027?')
g.text: Last window to submit under Version 1

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should companies with 2030 targets plan their 2030-2035 cycle under V2.0?')
sendPrompt('How do the scope 2 hourly matching recognition thresholds work?')
sendPrompt('What does mandatory ongoing emissions responsibility from 2035 require of Category A companies?')
sendPrompt('What does CNZS V2.0 require at the net-zero target year?')
